_comment: Mount manifest for building the Postgres dashboard.
package.json declares its @metabuilder/* dependencies as relative file:
paths (file:../../libraries/components and friends). Those resolve only
inside the old monorepo layout, where this repo sat at frontends/postgres
with its libraries beside it -- which is why a bare checkout cannot npm
install, and why CI here had never once gone green.
assemble_workspace.py rebuilds that layout: this repo is placed at
frontends/postgres and each sibling below is cloned into libraries/.
The file: paths then resolve unchanged, so neither package.json nor the
app source needs to know it is being built outside a monorepo.
icons is here despite not appearing in any package.json: components
imports it through a relative path ('../../icons/react/m3'), so grepping
for package names does not find it and omitting it fails the build with
Pins are commit SHAs for reproducibility; pass --floating to take branch

provides: shared SCSS imported by components and the app
resolved by components via a relative path, not a package name

repos._note: Not a dependency of the app, but of hooks and redux/{adapters,hooks-data}. Omitting it fails npm install with a 404 on @metabuilder/types@* -- the @metabuilder scope is not published to npm, so an unmounted package is not a version mismatch but a missing registry entry.
